description: This file contains utility functions for image processing, including reading files, decoding images, generating color palettes, creating image grids, drawing bounding boxes with labels, and converting tensors to numpy arrays. It is part of an image AI project, likely related to object detection or visualization.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file as a uint8 tensor.

methods.name: decode_image
methods.description: Decodes a tensor of raw image bytes into an image tensor, detecting JPEG or PNG format.

methods.name: read_image
methods.description: Reads an image file (JPEG or PNG) into a tensor, with optional mode for color format.

methods.name: _generate_color_palette
methods.description: Generates a color palette for a given number of objects, used for visualization.

methods.name: make_grid
methods.description: Creates a grid of images from a batch or list of tensors, with normalization and padding options.

methods.name: draw_bounding_boxes_and_labels
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and optional labels on an image tensor.

methods.name: tensor_to_ndarray
methods.description: Converts a tensor or list of tensors into a numpy ndarray, typically for visualization.
